context:
Goal: you cull the design-churn mockups down to the ones worth building.
Problem (goal): all 11 finishable mockups are finished and gathered (228 mockup files; merged to main under docs/design-churn, docs only, 2026-11-21 14:31 CST), nothing is built or merged, and only you can cull; the page cannot hold them all as pictures.
Based on (read): the coordinator's note of 2026-11-21 13:54 CST: the README table in docs/design-churn on main lists each mockup and its notes; each notes file lists its owner questions and "Owner grant: yes" items; the coordinator recommends you mark each mockup keep or drop from that table.
Based on (read): two facts every designer reports: no large-phone size is written anywhere (the phone-size question is still open), and the mockup checker faults the ruled Cochin content font on every mockup (a fix that belongs in the shared settings repo, not this one).
Departs from: main has no design-churn review — this adds one owner review.
Waiting on: your answer; the coordinator does nothing further meanwhile.
